channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: A política quer escolher até o nosso craque favorito
item.description: The Bolsonarist right appropriated the Brazilian national team's jersey as a symbol of nationalism and patriotism for political purposes. The left, for a long time, allowed this appropriation, but is now seeking to reclaim the symbol from the Bolsonarists, stating that it was time to reverse this situation.

item.title: Romeu Zema sobre escala 6x1: 'Infelizmente, o brasileiro ainda acredita nesse tipo de coisa'
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo Party's presidential pre-candidate and former governor of Minas Gerais, criticized the public's belief in measures like the 6x1 work scale, stating that 'unfortunately Brazilians still believe in this kind of thing'. His remarks reflect a liberal, skeptical stance toward labor proposals viewed as populist or economically unfeasible.

item.title: Zema critica debate sobre fim da escala 6×1 e defende reformas
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for President from the Novo party, criticized the debate over ending the 6×1 work schedule, arguing that Brazil needs reforms to boost the economy. Speaking at the 'Industry on the Presidential Candidates' Agenda' event in Brasília, he called for 'three shocks': morality, fiscal, and productivity, as essential for national development.

item.title: Flávio e Tarcísio terão novas agendas conjuntas nesta terça, após ato no final de semana
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) will meet in Presidente Prudente (SP) on Tuesday (23) for a joint agenda. The meeting follows a weekend event and strengthens the political alignment between the two right-wing leaders ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Os dois nomes do PP mais bem cotados para a vice de Flávio, segundo Derrite
item.description: Federal deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) stated that former minister Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) and deputy Simone Marquetto (PP-SP) are the top names being considered for vice president on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-SP) 2026 presidential ticket. He noted their differing profiles—Tereza with strong agribusiness ties and ministerial experience, Marquetto with broad political reach in São Paulo—and said both could strengthen the ticket. Derrite also addressed Ciro Nogueira's ties to Banco Master, advocating for a CPMI to investigate the matter.

item.title: TSE manda remover publicação gerada por IA que associava Flávio Bolsonaro a Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: The TSE ordered the removal of an AI-generated image linking Flávio Bolsonaro to detained banker Daniel Vorcaro, ruling it as electoral disinformation with potential to mislead voters on a politically relevant fact. Minister André Mendonça’s decision gave 24 hours to delete the post on X, barred republishing or boosting similar content, and instructed Instagram, Facebook, and X to comply, though it did not extend to comments or shares.

item.title: Presidente da CCJ defende Jaques Wagner: "Nada resiste ao trabalho"
item.description: Senator Otto Alencar (PSD-BA), president of the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ), publicly defended Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), the government leader in the Senate, after Wagner was targeted by Compliance Zero and investigated by the Federal Police over alleged ties to Banco Master frauds. Wagner denies wrongdoing, stating seized cash corresponds to official Senate travel allowances, while Alencar reiterated their long-standing alliance with the phrase 'Nothing resists work'.

item.title: Zema defende regime de trabalho por hora e critica CLT
item.description: Romeu Zema advocated for an hourly work regime as an alternative to the CLT, arguing that the current labor model is outdated and prevents informal workers from being formalized. He criticized judicial interference in labor relations, accused the judiciary of reversing congressional advances, and called for full privatization of state-owned enterprises, citing the Banco Master case as evidence of state inefficiency.

item.title: Lula tem 67,3% contra 20,6% de Flávio no 2º turno no PI, diz pesquisa
item.description: According to an AtlasIntel/Meio Norte poll released on June 22, 2026, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads the runoff in Piauí with 67.3% voting intentions versus 20.6% for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The survey, conducted June 16–21 with 1,197 respondents, has a 3-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Convocado como ‘Neymar da política’, Joaquim Barbosa tem desempenho pífio em pesquisa
item.description: Joaquim Barbosa, former STF justice and DC's presidential pre-candidate for 2026, has only 1% voter intention in a recent Datafolha poll, a poor performance following the controversial replacement of Aldo Rebelo as the party's nominee. The DC had promoted Barbosa as the 'Neymar of Brazilian politics' to boost electoral prospects, but the move triggered internal crisis, threats, and an unauthorized AI-generated deepfake video that Barbosa disliked. Despite creating social media profiles, Barbosa has remained largely silent on his campaign, while Rebelo is legally contesting the change and asserts he remains the party's official pre-candidate.

item.title: Petrobras e BNDES fecham parceria para pesquisa de minerais críticos
item.description: Petrobras and BNDES have signed a partnership to research critical minerals essential for the energy transition and the oil and gas sector, aiming to map gaps in the supply chain and leverage Brazil's vast rare earth reserves. The agreement was announced during the BNDES's 74th-anniversary ceremony, with President Lula in attendance, who emphasized the strategic importance of these resources for the future of industry. Despite having the world's second-largest rare earth reserves, Brazil's current production accounts for less than 1% of global output.

item.title: Crusoé: Michelle promete explicar “o que aconteceu no Ceará”
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro shared a statement from ex-minister Ciro Gomes, in which he said he would not support Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential elections. She promised to record a video explaining 'what happened in Ceará,' suggesting a political rebuttal to Ciro's stance. The post was made on X (formerly Twitter) and originally published by Crusoé, featuring a clip from Ciro’s interview with Veja magazine.

item.title: Comunicação da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro vive disputas internas em meio a baixa nas pesquisas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign communications are facing internal disputes amid declining polls and the fallout from his request for R$134 million from Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. Tensions center on strategy, social media control, and candidate branding, leading to departures of key staff including Fernando Pessoa and Marcello Lopes. The campaign is attempting to realign with core bolsonarismo to regain traction.

item.title: Neymar treina de novo e pode encarar a Escócia
item.description: Neymar trained normally on Monday and may be an option for coach Carlo Ancelotti in Wednesday's match against Scotland, though he is unlikely to start due to Raphinha's injury and the preference for three other players. He took 30 days to recover from a calf injury, returned to ball training last week, and skipped the Haiti trip to complete treatment. Lula's comment calling Neymar the 'world's first home office call-up' provoked right-wing reactions, underscoring the toxic political polarization that overshadows football.

item.title: Romeu Zema sobre fim da escala 6x1: ‘Infelizmente, o brasileiro ainda acredita nesse tipo de coisa’
item.description: Romeu Zema, pré-candidate of the Novo Party for the Presidency, criticized the PEC aiming to end the 6x1 work schedule, stating that Brazilians still believe in simplistic solutions to increase income and productivity. He advocated for an optional CLT with hourly work regimes, accused the federal government of criminalizing the productive sector, and highlighted that the Federation of Industries of Minas Gerais (Fiemg) acted as a secretariat in his administration. Zema also proposed lowering interest rates, reviewing social programs, administrative reform, and a new pension reform.

item.title: Termina nesta segunda (22) prazo para MRE solicitar seções eleitorais alternativas no exterior
item.description: The deadline for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to request alternative polling stations abroad ends this Monday (22), as per the 2026 Electoral Calendar. The goal is to expand voting access for the 917,066 Brazilian voters residing overseas, focusing on locations beyond embassies and consulates. The United States, Portugal, and Japan account for over half of this electorate, with Boston and Miami being the largest voter hubs in the U.S.

item.title: Moraes autoriza extensão do tempo de visita de advogados a Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has exceptionally authorized an extension of visitation time for Jair Bolsonaro's lawyers during his house arrest, starting at 2 p.m. on Tuesday, the 23rd. The measure allows the former president to prepare for his scheduled testimony on the same day.

item.title: Indústria pede redução do custo Brasil a presidenciáveis
item.description: The CNI urged presidential candidates to adopt a long-term agenda to reduce the 'Brazil Cost,' emphasizing macroeconomic stability, state-led industrial policy, and structural reform, following the decline of manufacturing from 35.9% to 13.7% of GDP between 1985 and 2025.

item.title: O encontro de Flávio Bolsonaro com embaixadores
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's pre-candidate for presidency, will meet with foreign ambassadors in Brasília on July 7 to discuss his government plans, as part of the 'Debating Brazil' cycle organized by The Brazilian Report and Novo Selo Comunicação. The event will also feature other pre-candidates such as Romeu Zema (Novo) and Renan Santos (Missão), aiming to strengthen his image as a leader with international projection. In the first meeting of the series, TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques addressed the security of the 2024 elections.

item.title: A escapada de Valdemar para assistir à seleção na Copa do Mundo
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL party, traveled to the United States to watch the Brazil vs. Scotland World Cup match live, despite his campaign schedule. He returns to Brazil the following day and is expected to attend the Senate candidacy launch of Wilder Morais in Goiânia alongside Flávio Bolsonaro. There are no official commitments with Eduardo Bolsonaro or other U.S.-based leaders.

item.title: Zema critica debate sobre escala 6 X 1 e defende reformas
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pre-candidate, criticized the debate over reducing the workweek (6x1 scale) and advocated for structural reforms to lower interest rates and boost productivity. He emphasized the need for 'shocks' in morality, public spending control, and crime, alongside reforms to pensions, public administration, and social programs—conditioning benefits on accepting job offers or training. Zema linked public safety to economic growth, citing reduced ATM explosions in Minas Gerais as evidence of his administration's success.

item.title: Aliados temem saia-justa entre Lula e Jaques Wagner em evento na Bahia
item.description: The relationship between President Lula and Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) is strained following a Federal Police operation that seized money from his hotel and his interview on Bandnews, in which Wagner claimed Lula called to express solidarity and reiterated his intention to remain as government leader and run for re-election in 2026. Despite being the rapporteur of the law that symbolically transfers the federal government seat to Salvador on July 2, allies fear an awkward moment at the event, given Wagner’s involvement in a financial scandal with banker Daniel Vorcaro and his perception as a 'traitor' within the Palácio do Planalto. His position as Senate government leader remains uncertain, creating tension in an election year.

item.title: O papel de Janja na campanha de Lula
item.description: First Lady Janja has been working behind the scenes in Lula’s 2026 presidential campaign, engaging with PT factions, particularly women’s groups and evangelical communities, and contributing to the development of the government program. Her role is described as primarily organizational, focusing on women’s, children’s, and adolescent rights, as well as animal protection, with regular activity at the PT headquarters in Brasília.

item.title: Jaques Wagner avalia permanência no governo com aliados na Bahia
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) met with allies in Bahia to assess his continued role as Senate government leader after being targeted in the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero, which investigates fraud at Banco Master. Although he denied commercial ties with the bank or Credcesta, he acknowledged negotiating a R$ 2.5 million apartment with Augusto Lima, a former Master partner, proposing a buy-and-sell-back arrangement. PT factions in Congress are pushing to keep him in leadership, citing presumption of innocence and advocating for a CPMI on the Master case, while Wagner maintains confidence in the investigations and denies any wrongdoing.

item.title: Janones quer montar QG de campanha em condomínio onde Bolsonaro mora
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) plans to rent a property in the Solar de Brasília condominium, where former President Jair Bolsonaro is under house arrest, to establish a campaign headquarters for the presidential race with the goal of confronting Bolsonaro. Janones stated the move aims to show the opposition is not afraid and is willing to play the same political game as the adversary. Bolsonaro’s house arrest, initially set to end on June 25, may be extended due to health issues like bronchopneumonia, while his defense requests new medical exams.

item.title: Decisão de André Mendonça sinaliza nova fase da guerra eleitoral entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: The decision by Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça regarding the removal of social media content reignites the debate over the limits of electoral justice in combating disinformation. Experts note that such judicial intervention, intensified since 2019 with STF inquiries and Alexandre de Moraes’ leadership at the TSE, is likely to become a defining feature of the 2026 elections, as candidates increasingly turn to the judiciary to challenge opponents’ posts. The issue raises critical questions about balancing disinformation countermeasures with freedom of expression, raising constitutional concerns over potential censorship.

item.title: Lula espera que Jaques Wagner entregue o cargo na liderança do Senado, dizem aliados
item.description: President Lula expects Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) to step down as government leader in the Senate following a Federal Police operation in the Master Case, where Wagner is suspected of receiving undue advantages from Daniel Vorcaro’s bank. His continued presence is seen as unsustainable, undermining the government’s anti-corruption narrative and hindering the PT’s strategy to link the scandal to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. A decision on Wagner’s future will be made in an in-person meeting with Lula this week.

item.title: Ipsos: Lula tem melhora em avaliação, mas saldo do governo segue negativo
item.description: The Ipsos-Ipec poll shows a slight improvement in Lula's government regular rating (up from 24% to 28%) and a small drop in negative perception (down from 40% to 38%), though the overall balance remains negative. Approval of the government rose to 32% (excellent/good), while trust in the president reached 41% and disapproval stood at 50%. Positive views are strongest among Northeasterners, less educated, and low-income groups; negative views among Bolsonaro voters, evangelicals, the highly educated, and high-income earners.

item.title: As pesquisas que vão medir o impacto de Jaques Wagner na campanha de Lula
item.description: New electoral polls for the 2026 Brazilian presidency begin publication next week, but most did not capture the full impact of the Federal Police operation against Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), a longtime Lula ally investigated for alleged involvement in Banco Master frauds. The latest Datafolha poll, released on May 20, conducted fieldwork between May 17–19, before the PF acted on May 18, so it does not reflect the scandal’s consequences. Upcoming surveys from BTG/Nexus (May 29), AtlasIntel (next week), and Genial/Quaest (first half of July) are expected to measure the effect of the Wagner allegations on voter perception and Lula’s campaign.

item.title: Aécio põe freio em articulação do PSDB de SP pró-Tarcísio e diz que decisão será do comando nacional
item.description: The national leadership of the PSDB has halted efforts by São Paulo party members to support the re-election of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas of the Republicans, stating that the decision will be made later based on a national party strategy.

item.title: GSI designa major “Fulano de Tal” como assistente na segurança de Lula
item.description: The Institutional Security Cabinet (GSI) appointed Army Major 'Fulano de Tal' and 1st Lieutenant of the Federal District Military Police (PMDF) 'Cicrano de Tal' as assistants in the security detail for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), according to a notice published in the Official Gazette on April 22. The appointment followed an internal error, as indicated in the original report.

item.title: Ipsos-Ipec: 56% dos brasileiros dizem não confiar no presidente Lula
item.description: Ipsos-Ipec poll shows 56% of Brazilians do not trust President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, while 41% express trust, maintaining trends from prior surveys. Distrust is higher among men, those with high school or college education, ages 25–34, individuals earning over five minimum wages, and evangelicals. The Lula government is seen as worse than expected by 42% of Brazilians, with the Northeast being the only region where positive evaluations outweigh negative ones.

item.title: Condenado, Eduardo vai a Washington para nova ofensiva contra STF
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) traveled to Washington, D.C., to meet with Trump administration officials and Republican lawmakers, seeking political backing to overturn his STF conviction and advocate for the application of the Magnitsky Act against Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. Accompanied by journalist Paulo Figueiredo, he is engaged in a series of meetings through Tuesday, including a dinner with approximately 20 Republican senators, aiming to promote a narrative of judicial persecution against Bolsonaro allies.

item.title: Mendonça não vê pedido de voto em post que diz ‘futuro presidente Flávio Bolsonaro’
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça rejected requests to remove posts by federal deputy Mario Frias using phrases like 'future president Flávio Bolsonaro' and 'I support Flávio Bolsonaro for president', ruling they do not constitute explicit vote solicitation or premature electoral propaganda, but rather political support and personal preference, which are permissible in the pre-campaign period.

item.title: Jogo do Brasil com Haiti reduz consumo de energia em até 9,6%
item.description: Brazil's 3-0 victory over Haiti in the 2026 World Cup caused a maximum 9.6% drop in national electricity consumption, reaching a low of 73,616 MW at 11:30 PM. The decline began at 8:30 PM, equivalent to Rio de Janeiro's average consumption, with sharp rebounds during halftime and post-match, reflecting typical viewing behavior during Seleção games.

item.title: O que é a nova sede do governo de SP que será erguida na antiga ‘Cracolândia’
item.description: The São Paulo state government plans to build a new administrative headquarters at Princesa Isabel Square in the city center, currently known as 'Cracolândia'. The project includes seven buildings and ten towers across 288,000 m², with an estimated cost of R$ 5.5 billion, to house 22,500 employees starting in 2030. It involves the expropriation of at least 600 families, relocation to social housing, and the requalification of the bus terminal to improve integration with train and metro systems.

item.title: Lula chama governador interino do RJ de interventor, e os dois trocam elogios
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva referred to Rio de Janeiro's interim governor, Ricardo Couto, as an 'interventor' during the ceremony signing the state's adhesion to the Propag program, which addresses state debt payments. Despite the potentially critical term, Lula and Couto exchanged mutual praise, emphasizing federal-state cooperation in Rio de Janeiro's fiscal recovery.

item.title: Lula e Rio de Janeiro assinam adesão ao Propag
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Rio de Janeiro's interim governor Ricardo Couto signed the state's adhesion to the Propag program, reducing Rio's debt from over R$200 billion to R$160 billion, eliminating interest rates, and saving approximately R$1.3 billion monthly in payments to the Union. The agreement allocates 2% of the debt balance to investments, including R$2.4 billion for middle and technical education, with social spending commitments of R$900 million in 2026 and R$2.2 billion in 2027.

item.title: Jaques Wagner tenta encontro com Lula após operação da PF
item.description: Senate government leader Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) is seeking a meeting with President Lula (PT) to discuss the Federal Police investigation against him. Wagner is set to arrive in Brasília on Wednesday, the 24th, and the meeting is expected to occur on the same day to address the implications of the PF operation.

item.title: Quem lidera as pesquisas para governador nos dez estados mais populosos do Brasil
item.description: In the latest polls for governor in 2026 across Brazil's ten most populous states, Tarcísio de Freitas leads in São Paulo with 49%, while Cleitinho Azevedo holds a strong lead in Minas Gerais, ranging from 30% to 37%. In São Paulo, Fernando Haddad follows with 33%, and in Minas Gerais, Alexandre Kalil trails between 14% and 16%.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula anuncia investimentos para favelas do Rio de Janeiro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced on Monday morning (June 22, 2026) investments for favelas and peripheral areas in Rio de Janeiro, including Complexo da Maré, Rocinha, and Jardim Maravilha, during an event in Jardim Maravilha, West Zone. The announcement follows his participation in the ceremony formalizing Rio’s adhesion to the state debt renegotiation program, part of a week-long agenda of infrastructure deliveries and agreements across states, blending administrative duties with political outreach in an election year.

item.title: Ipsos/Ipec: 50% dos brasileiros desaprovam a gestão Lula; 44% aprovam
item.description: The June Ipsos/Ipec poll shows 50% of Brazilians disapprove of Lula's government, while 44% approve, remaining stable since March. Positive ratings (excellent/good) fell to 32%, and 56% say they do not trust the president, reflecting a negative balance and polarized public opinion.

item.title: Carlos diz que “renasceu” em SC ao justificar pré-candidatura pelo Estado
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro announced his pre-candidacy for the Senate from Santa Catarina, justifying his change of electoral domicile with the phrase 'here I was reborn,' despite not being born in the state. His candidacy caused internal tensions in the PL of SC, which opted for a 'pure ticket' alongside federal deputy Carol de Toni, abandoning a potential alliance with the Progressistas and Esperidião Amin. The candidacy will only be formalized after party conventions and TSE registration in August.

item.title: Neymar é um "come e dorme" da Seleção Brasileira, dispara Morelli
item.description: Robson Morelli criticized Neymar's call-up for the 2026 World Cup, stating the player fails to deliver the intensity required by the tournament and labeled him a 'come and sleeper' for the Brazilian national team. Despite being injured and not having debuted, Neymar is in the final stages of recovery and may play against Scotland. Morelli questioned the technical justification for the call-up, saying Ancelotti has yet to explain why Neymar was selected.

item.title: Os índices de popularidade de Lula, segundo nova pesquisa Ipsos-Ipec
item.description: An Ipsos/Ipec poll released on June 22, 2026 shows 50% of voters disapprove of President Lula's (PT) administration, while 44% approve, with 6% undecided or unresponsive. The results reflect stability compared to the March survey, when 51% disapproved and 43% approved. Negative evaluations are strongest among Bolsonaro voters (74%), those with household income above five minimum wages (54%), evangelicals (49%), and those with higher education (46%).

item.title: Supremo valida emenda que anistia partidos políticos que violaram cotas eleitorais
item.description: The Federal Supreme Court validated by a 6-4 vote Constitutional Amendment 133/2024, which grants amnesty to political parties for fines related to non-compliance with racial quotas in electoral financing and mandates that parties invest previously unspent funds into Black and mixed-race candidacies over the next four elections, maintaining the 30% allocation from party and campaign funds. Justice Cristiano Zanin, the rapporteur, argued the measure is not an illegal amnesty but a transitional model to strengthen political representation of an underrepresented group, warning that overturning it would create a legal vacuum regarding mandatory financing for Black candidacies.

item.title: Prefeito de NY recebe camisas do Corinthians após fala sobre Sócrates
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani received Corinthians jerseys in recognition of his public tribute to Sócrates and the Corinthian Democracy. The gift was presented by club officials and former player Walter Casagrande following a video in which Mamdani praised Sócrates' political activism during Brazil's military dictatorship. The gesture took place just days before Brazil's 2026 World Cup opener against Morocco.

item.title: Lula chama Ricardo Couto de ‘interventor’ e sela entrada do Rio no Propag
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva formalized Rio de Janeiro's accession to the Full Payment of States' Debts Program (Propag), emphasizing that interim governor and judge Ricardo Couto must act as an 'intervener' in managing the funds saved from debt renegotiation. Lula praised Couto's competence and stated that investments in technical vocational education, state universities, and early childhood education will serve as the program's counterpart, aiming to free youth from organized crime. Couto pledged to leave the state with a surplus of 1 to 5 billion reais by the end of his interim term, reversing the projected 19.5 billion reais deficit from the previous administration.

item.title: Damares pede a presidente do TSE força-tarefa para retirada imediata de deep fakes das redes
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) urged TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques to act swiftly in removing AI-generated deep fake content from social media during a parliamentary meeting last week. She called for an emergency task force to combat electoral disinformation powered by artificial intelligence.

item.title: Mendonça manda remover vídeo de líder do PL na Câmara que associa PT a facções criminosas
item.description: TSE Vice-President André Mendonça ordered the removal of a video posted by PL congressional leader Sóstenes Cavalcante, which alleged that the PT received illegal campaign funding from criminal factions such as the Comando Vermelho and PCC. The decision was made to prevent misinformation and protect the integrity of the electoral process.
